checks: 'Additional living quarters (not a dwelling unit)' may be established as accessory to a principal single-family dwelling unit 'for immediate family members only': parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren (1910B(8)(a))
The principal dwelling unit is owner-occupied. The quarters may not be leased or rented as an apartment or separate dwelling unit (1910B(8)(b), (i))

The quarters are 'totally enclosed within the principal building' with an internal connection such as a stairway or door, not in a separate building joined by a corridor or breezeway. An addition is allowed if the house still looks like a single-family detached dwelling from the street and other properties. 'Detached additional living quarters and additional dwelling units are specifically prohibited' (1910B(8)(c), (d), (g), (h))

One-year renewable permit from the Zoning Officer, renewed each year with proof that family members still live there, and inspection on request. A deed restriction with the conditions is recorded with the Montgomery County Recorder of Deeds. Cooking facilities are removed within six months after no family member lives there (1910B(8)(e), (j), (k), (l))
On-lot septic system: found adequate by the County Health Department for the expanded use (1910B(8)(f))

No size cap, no parking line and no limit of one unit are written for the quarters. Parking for a dwelling is 'One (1) all-weather parking space per family on the same lot' (1700A). Whether the quarters count as a second family for parking is not said

A dwelling unit needs 'complete housekeeping facilities for one (1) family' and 'private ingress and egress facilities' (200, dwelling 7). The quarters are expressly not a dwelling unit, so the house stays a single-family detached dwelling

Conversion of a single-family dwelling into a dwelling for more families is a special exception anywhere (1912): a petition by owners of 60% of the frontage within 500 ft, each unit at least 500 sq ft, lot area per family at least 75% of the district figure, no exterior change, only for a large dwelling with little economic usefulness as a conforming use
D Residential permits duplex dwellings (two units on one lot 'attached ceiling to floor') by right: 3,000 sq ft per family, width 60 ft, side yards 10 ft and 25 ft together (802)

Residential districts: one detached private garage and one storage shed per lot (a second garage by special exception). Garages 16 ft high, 32 by 24 ft in AA and A, 24 by 24 ft elsewhere (1908.1). Detached garages and sheds stand in the side or rear yard at least 10 ft behind the rear of the house, 4 ft from side and rear lines (3 ft in D and D-1) (1908G)

Living quarters for household employees, caretakers or watchmen are an accessory use to a dwelling, in the house or in an accessory structure that meets the principal building yards and coverage (1910B(3)). Not a unit for a household of its own
Plymouth Township Historic District (Chapter 7): exterior work needs a certificate of appropriateness after Historical Architectural Review Board review. It is not a zoning use path
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Plymouth Township Code Enforcement (Zoning Officer). Read on eCode360 (PL1880) in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. Zoning is Appendix B. Code search (all content) for 'accessory apartment', 'accessory dwelling', 'in-law', ECHO, 'elder cottage', granny, 'family dwelling', relative, 'housekeeping unit', caretaker, 'guest house', 'accessory living', 'tenant house', conversion, duplex and 'two-family' did not find 1910B(8). A second search for 'living quarters', 'additional dwelling', 'immediate family' and 'accessory use' found it. Read in full: Articles II (definitions), IV to IX (AA, A, B, C, D, D-1, RS), XVII (parking), XIX (general provisions) and XXXIX (MUV). Not read: Commercial (X), Shopping Center, Office Laboratory, industrial, Limited Commercial, Open Space Recreation, Cluster Development Overlay (XXXI), planned office park, mixed use planned development and business park use lists, Article XXI (Zoning Hearing Board powers), nonconforming lots (1801).

term.note: 'Additional living quarters (not a dwelling unit) may be established as accessory to a principal single-family dwelling unit for immediate family members only.'

status.note: An accessory use to a single-family dwelling for immediate family members only, inside the house, owner-occupied, with a one-year renewable permit from the Zoning Officer.

status_by_form.note: 'Detached additional living quarters and additional dwelling units are specifically prohibited.' A garage conversion here means a detached garage. Space in an attached garage that becomes part of the house is the internal form.

scope_by_use.note: The quarters are accessory to a principal single-family dwelling. AA, A, B, C and D permit single-family detached dwellings. D-1 permits only duplexes and townhouses. RS permits the uses of the least restricted abutting residential district. MUV permits single-family detached dwellings only within a conditional use MUV development.

status_outside.note: No single-family dwelling, so no additional living quarters.

path.note: An accessory use. 'A one-year renewable permit issued by the Township Zoning Officer shall be required.' No hearing.

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. Article XXI was not read.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling into a dwelling for more families
value.conditions: Zoning Hearing Board special exception. A petition signed by the owners of 60% or more of the frontage on the same street within 500 ft. Each unit at least 500 sq ft. Lot area per family at least 75% of the district requirement. Yards and building area not reduced. No external alteration except for safety. Parking met. Only for 'a large dwelling with relatively little economic usefulness as a conforming use', or another arrangement the Board finds within the ordinance's intent.

requires.condition: A petition signed by owners of 60% or more of the frontage on the same street within 500 ft
A large dwelling with relatively little economic usefulness as a conforming use

value.note: Each unit is a dwelling unit. Not an ADU listing. The lot area per family is 75% of each district's figure, which the section does not restate by district.

value.name: Duplex dwelling in D Residential
value.conditions: Two dwelling units on one lot, 'attached ceiling to floor'. 3,000 sq ft of lot area per family (6,000 for two), width 60 ft, building coverage 30%, impervious surface 50%, front 25 ft, side yards 10 ft and 25 ft together, rear 25 ft.
value.note: Adding a unit above or below the existing one in a house is read as this use. Not an ADU listing.

zoning_districts.note: Districts that permit a single-family detached dwelling.

building_types.note: Accessory to a principal single-family dwelling. Its look 'as a single-family detached dwelling' is kept (1910B(8)(g)).

historic_bypass.note: No historic path. The Historic District (Chapter 7) adds a certificate of appropriateness for exterior work.

districts_read_no_listing.note: Two-family duplex and townhouse dwellings only.

value.condition: For immediate family members only: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren.
The principal dwelling unit is owner-occupied. The quarters may not be leased or rented as an apartment or separate dwelling unit.

Totally enclosed within the principal building with an internal connection (stairway or door). Not a separate building joined by a corridor or breezeway. Exterior changes keep the look of a single-family detached dwelling.

One-year renewable permit from the Zoning Officer, renewed with proof of family occupancy, inspection on request. Recorded deed restriction. Cooking facilities removed within six months after no family member lives there.
An on-lot septic system must be found adequate by the County Health Department for the expanded use.

types_allowed.note: 'Totally enclosed within the principal building'. An addition to the house ('an attached additional living quarters', (g)) is part of the principal building.

internal_uses_district_height.note: 35 ft for any dwelling (401A, applied in A, B, C and D).

owner_occupancy.note: 'The principal dwelling unit shall be owner-occupied.'

occupancy.value: Immediate family members of the owner only: parents, grandparents, children, grandchildren, sisters, brothers, aunts, uncles, stepparents and stepchildren. No rent.

max_adus.note: No count is written. The section speaks of 'additional living quarters' in the singular.

spaces_required.note: No parking line for the quarters.

reading.value: A dwelling needs 'One (1) all-weather parking space per family on the same lot' (1700A). If the quarters count only as part of the house's family, 1 space in all. If they count as a second family, 2.
